PR title:
Disallow use of is_flag and multiple in options

PR body:
Raises a TypeError similar to when specifying both `count=True` and `is_flag=True`.

- fixes #2246

Checklist:

- [x] Add tests that demonstrate the correct behavior of the change. Tests should fail without the change.
- [ ] Add or update relevant docs, in the docs folder and in code.
- [ ] Add an entry in `CHANGES.rst` summarizing the change and linking to the issue.
- [ ] Add `.. versionchanged::` entries in any relevant code docs.
- [x] Run `pre-commit` hooks and fix any issues.
- [x] Run `pytest` and `tox`, no tests failed.

message.content: When creating an option, specifying both `multiple=True` and `is_flag=True` does not raise an error, but these two settings are incompatible and should not be allowed together.
